children: Tripathi joins from Quick Heal with over 20 years of experience in technology marketing, business growth and global go-to-market strategy

Nucleus Software has appointed Sudhanshu Tripathi as Chief Marketing Officer, effective 21 September 2026, as the banking technology company looks to strengthen its global growth and market positioning.

Tripathi brings more than 20 years of experience across technology marketing, business strategy, revenue growth, demand generation, category creation and international expansion. He joins Nucleus Software from Quick Heal Technologies, where he served as Chief Marketing Officer and Head of Environmental, Social and Governance (ESG).

At Quick Heal, Tripathi led brand and growth initiatives across consumer and enterprise businesses, including the company’s digital business. His experience also includes leadership roles at Sterlite Power, Cyient, FINO PayTech and Tata Consultancy Services, spanning cybersecurity, digital infrastructure, financial services and enterprise technology.

At Nucleus Software, Tripathi will lead the company’s global marketing strategy, covering brand, go-to-market, demand generation, category development, corporate reputation, analyst engagement and partner-led growth.

Nucleus Software serves more than 200 banks and financial institutions across 50 countries, with its platforms supporting lending and transaction banking operations. Its flagship products include FinnOne Neo for digital lending and FinnAxia for transaction banking.
